author: allnes
title: Windows VS 2022 workflow logs unavailable - run re-queued automatically on attempt 2
signature: Windows VS2022 workflow run failed - job logs unavailable due to secrecy policy|Infrastructure
failed_jobs: Windows (VS 2022, Python 3.11, Release) - attempt 1 (no recoverable log data)
key_errors: Workflow run concluded as 'failure' on attempt 1. Attempt 2 auto-started. No failed job logs are available to CI Doctor (secrecy/policy restriction on self-hosted Windows runners). This matches a known recurrent pattern.
root_cause: The Windows VS 2022 Release workflow failed on attempt 1 with no retrievable job logs. This is a known recurring infrastructure issue on self-hosted Windows runners in the OpenVINO merge queue: the run concludes as 'failure' before all jobs complete or logs are accessible, and the system automatically triggers a second attempt. The actual underlying cause per historical pattern: transient infrastructure event on the self-hosted AKS Windows runner (resource pressure, runner reset, or artifact service timeout).
reproduction_steps: N/A — transient infrastructure failure; not reproducible locally.
recommended_actions: Monitor attempt 2 (currently running) to confirm it passes.
If attempt 2 also fails, inspect the specific job logs for the actual error.
File an infra ticket if this pattern continues to recur weekly.
prevention_strategies: Increase self-hosted Windows runner pool capacity and add health checks. Configure retry logic for artifact upload steps.
historical_context: This is the 9th occurrence of this pattern (cc822c07e113be0a), first seen 2026-07-24. Previous occurrences resolved by automatic re-queue on attempt 2.
